front.title: Cross-Protocol Semantic Equivalence Proofs and Commit-Bound Metering Receipts for Multi-Vendor Agentic Exchanges

abstract.t: Enterprise agent ecosystems routinely bridge tool invocations and task delegations across heterogeneous protocols, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), and OpenAPI/REST. During protocol translation, safety invariants, schema constraints, and mutability flags are frequently stripped—enabling cross-protocol capability downgrade attacks—while commercial settlement gateways erroneously bill on HTTP 200 transport responses rather than verified state-commit durability. This document specifies a cryptographic Cross-Protocol Semantic Equivalence Proof (CPSEP) and an 8-state Commit-Bound Metering Receipt (CBMR) protocol.
